question: Which deity is designated the presiding power of the mantras in the eastern direction?
premises: The eastern direction is specified as the locus of the rite.
Agnimahādurgā is named as the deity to be established there.
This deity holds presiding authority over the mantras.
inference: Agnimahādurgā is to be established in the east as the presiding deity of the mantras.
uncertainties: The governing verb is supplied from the preceding ritual context of establishing and kindling the fire.
plain_english: In the east, one should establish Agnimahādurgā as the presiding deity of the mantras.
